title: 去美元化被夸大：花旗高管说透，美元仍占储备主导
speaker: Stephanie von Friedenburg

segments.en: What about when it comes to the FX reserves? What are you seeing in them diversifying? Are you seeing any signs of de-dollarization?
segments.zh: 那外汇储备方面呢？你看到他们在分散配置什么？有去美元化的迹象吗？

segments.en: Avril, it's a great question. Central banks are my clients, and they ask me this question all the time.
segments.zh: Avril，这是个好问题。央行是我的客户，他们总是问我这个问题。

segments.en: So I want to start with de-dollarization. I think it's an exaggerated term.
segments.zh: 我想从去美元化开始。我认为这个词被夸大了。

segments.en: What I really believe is that the dollar will remain the reserve currency for the foreseeable future.
segments.zh: 我真正相信的是，美元在可预见的未来仍将是储备货币。

segments.en: It's really remained since the 1950s within a peg of 45 to 80% of reserves. It's still well within that range.
segments.zh: 自1950年代以来，它一直保持在45%到80%的储备占比区间内。目前仍远在该范围内。

segments.en: But what we are seeing is diversification on the margin.
segments.zh: 但我们看到的是边际上的分散配置。

segments.en: And for central bank governors and central bank staff, that's the right thing to do because concentration risk matters.
segments.zh: 对央行行长和员工来说，这是正确的做法，因为集中度风险很重要。

segments.en: So the question then becomes what do they diversify into?
segments.zh: 那么问题就变成了，他们分散配置到什么？

segments.en: So what are they buying? What have they been buying in this past year?
segments.zh: 他们在买什么？过去一年他们一直在买什么？

segments.en: There are a couple of different things. So first, they're being more innovative. They're thinking about digital solutions, and they're innovating.
segments.zh: 有几件不同的事。首先，他们更具创新性。他们在考虑数字解决方案，并在创新。

segments.en: But maybe most importantly is that they've been moving to gold. And there are really two different kinds of central banks.
segments.zh: 但也许最重要的是，他们一直在转向黄金。实际上有两种不同的央行。

segments.en: There are central banks that had very little exposure to gold in their portfolio. They've been buying because it doesn't have counter-party risk.
segments.zh: 有些央行投资组合中黄金敞口很小。他们一直在买入，因为黄金没有交易对手风险。

segments.en: It's a very safe place to move their money.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常安全的资金去处。

segments.en: Central banks that had a lot of gold in their portfolio early on are now asking us the question, what should we do about our gold?
segments.zh: 那些早期投资组合中持有大量黄金的央行，现在问我们，我们该怎么处理黄金？

segments.en: Because it's twice its value. So should they sell some gold? Should they borrow against that gold? Should they hedge that gold?
segments.zh: 因为黄金价值翻倍了。所以他们应该卖出一些黄金吗？应该以黄金借入吗？应该对冲黄金吗？

segments.en: That's a conversation we didn't see two or three years ago.
segments.zh: 这是两三年前我们没有看到的对话。
